original_test_intent: Set one explicitly approved BMC System Info parameter with correct selector/data sequencing, verify exact readback and restore test-only metadata without changing unrelated inventory.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its refusal to run placeholders is safe, but it does not define the required pre-read, ownership, one-write, readback and restore transaction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After explicit approval, issue one exact `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x58 <selector> <encoded-data>` transaction using documented sequencing, then read back with 0x06/0x59.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Selector list, Table reference and 10/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a baseline-bound read/modify/readback/restore transaction for one approved parameter.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ownership, encoding, unrelated-field and rollback controls while keeping the original functional write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only Get evidence cannot prove the setter accepts, persists and returns an approved value.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong encoding or abandoned Set In Progress may corrupt metadata or block another writer.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it changes the same parameter with identical persistence and exposes exact before/after values; raw-path coverage remains noted if skipped.
expected_evidence: Target, selector, revision and original value
Approved encoded payload and Set In Progress plan

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source purpose and Set/Get commands align; placeholders and weak acceptance require project binding but are not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The setter semantics are identifiable. Exact project value, ownership and recovery are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines an auditable single-parameter transaction and prevents guessed metadata, broad rewrites or unsafe retry.
independent_technical_reasoning: System Info strings can span blocks and Set In Progress coordinates multi-part updates. A command completion without revision-aware full readback can leave truncated data or an owned parameter set, so the acceptance must bind the original bytes, exact encoded payload, post-state and restoration rather than rely on displayed text alone.
